scope: F30 operation SDK receipt and complete image/picture/returned movie/placeholder family API obligations; inherited and underscore-prefixed entries retained.

operation.name: images.list
operation.sdk: readImages(input: BinaryInput, options: ReadImagesOptions, context: SelectionContext): Promise<ImageInventory>
operation.cli: pptx images list INPUT [--scope SCOPE] [--slide N] [--image N] [--select TOKEN] [--unique] [--json]

languageMappings.admission: Always async bytes/stream or explicit capability-scoped VFS input. No path inference, native image runtime, ambient filesystem or network.
languageMappings.indexing: CLI picture positions are one-based within owning parts. Fallback references share a picture position. Structural reference IDs remain distinct.
languageMappings.density: Missing/invalid density uses 72 per axis. Finite numbers round to the nearest integer with ties-to-even, then must be in 1..2048. Numeric strings are rejected without coercion; this differs from source float coercion, not its rounding rule. See image-density-evidence.md.
languageMappings.dimensions: PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF bounded header metadata, not pixel decoding or image validity certification. Unsupported vector intrinsic dimensions are null.
languageMappings.hash: SHA-256 identifies admitted bytes; explicit unique groups hashes while preserving contributing parts. Media sha1 exposes independently tested compatibility metadata, never the integrity identity. Mixed MIME groups retain all declarations, null dimensions and default DPI.
languageMappings.ownership: Inventory is a detached noncreating read, not live Image/Picture model objects. Local placement corners and inherited slide membership do not promise rendering.
languageMappings.names: Neutral model property spellings remain required; operation fields use camelCase and do not replace the model API.
languageMappings.selection: Default slides only; explicit shared is the union of known drawing owners. Slide filtering also applies to notes/layout/master ancestry. --image selects picture positions only, excluding backgrounds and ordinary shape fills; opaque owner/object tokens can select their scope. Empty read selections succeed.

drift.decision: Notes drawing inspection does not invent add_picture methods on NotesSlideShapes.
Historical not-implemented statements describe the initial audit. This receipt establishes only the verified operation/header subset, not complete image model support.
